text: Built-in checks selecting the exact internal/verify package, through its Go files, embedded assets or acceptance tests, give the shared touched-test phase twenty minutes inside a twenty-five-minute Sandbox.Run (#498). Checks selecting only other packages keep D-0281's ten inside twelve, and a child package such as internal/verify/pythongate doesn't select its parent. Ownership discovery keeps the ordinary twelve-minute bound, and the longer deadline still counts from entry or queue admission. Direct builds that can select internal/verify ask for 26 min 15 s of tool time; queued builds keep their allowances, and repository-contract checks keep their limits. A whole uncached run of internal/verify takes about ten minutes (D-0296), so a change to it, such as #497's, couldn't pass the factory's own checks inside ten.
